&<color_light_green> @User > skill -RECALIBRATE -help
</color> skill: RECALIBRATE
   Available if ᴴᵁᴹᴬᴺ is not attuned to their own reality.
   Blood is required for temporary reality stabilization.
   The user will return to their reality, then be extracted by AltarOS remote after the estimated time, 4 EARTH HOURS, has elapsed.
   The user will return to the home away from home.  ᵍᵉᵗ ᵒᵇʲᵉᶜᵗˢ ᶠᵒʳ ᵘˢ
   Repeated visits will reattune the user to their own reality.
   WARNING: Dimensional instability will make ᴴᵁᴹᴬᴺ communication impossible.

identity: 9) Vitakinesis: Control of health and vitality, such as bloodflow, susceptibility to disease, healing speed, and need for sleep.  Master vitakinesists can slow or staunch bloodflow, increase the recovery rate of their whole body or a particular part of it, meditate instead of sleep, purge themselves of toxins or diseases, disrupt the bodily functions of their enemies, and heal grievous wounds in minutes.
